info.name: RingCentral RingCX Voice API
info.description: Requests for the public RingCX Voice APIs. Import the companion environment template, configure JWT credentials, and run Auth and setup before calling API requests. Select requests individually; running the entire collection would invoke operations that create, update, or delete RingCX resources.

item.name: Auth and setup
item.description: Run these requests in order. They use environment variables and save only short-lived tokens and account identifiers to the selected Postman environment.

item.name: 1. Get RingCentral access token

request.description: Uses the app client credentials and JWT from the selected environment to obtain a RingCentral access token. This token is used for the RingCX token exchange and RingCentral account UID lookup.

item.name: 2. Exchange for RingCX access token

request.description: Exchanges the RingCentral access token for a RingCX access token. The exchange is limited to five requests per minute, and the returned RingCX token is valid for five minutes.

item.name: 3. Get RingCX account IDs

request.description: Returns the RingCX accounts available to the authenticated user. The test script stores the first accountId as rcx_sub_account_id and its mainAccountId as rcx_main_account_id.

item.name: 4. Get RingCentral account UID

request.description: Uses the RingCentral access token from step 1 to retrieve the RingCentral account UID used by RingCX CX integration paths.

Max queue time.
